entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wilhelm Christian Benecke von Gröditzberg, né Wilhelm Christian Benecke, was a German banker, merchant, estate owner and art collector. He was ennobled in 1829 as Benecke von Gröditzberg, after he had bought the fief Gröditzberg including a baroque palace and medieval Castle Gröditzberg in Silesia.
